input.problem: I made an eggless vanilla sponge using a yogurt-and-baking-soda swap for the eggs. It rose well but sank in the middle as it cooled, and the bottom layer is dense and gummy.
input.recipe: 200g flour, 150g sugar, 120ml oil, 120g yogurt, 1 tsp baking soda, 1 tsp baking powder

input.problem: My egg-free chocolate chip cookies use a flax egg and they came out crumbly and fell apart when I picked them up. They also taste a bit dry.
I tried an egg-free brioche. The dough was very sticky, never really got smooth, and the loaf came out dense with a pale, thick crust instead of a soft golden one.
input.technicalDetails: Stand mixer, 10 minutes kneading, proofed 2 hours at about 21C

input.problem: My dairy-free chocolate cake made with coconut oil came out greasy on the bottom and sank in the middle. It looked fine when it went in the oven.
I swapped butter for a vegan butter block in my usual sugar cookie recipe. The cookies spread into thin, crispy sheets and merged on the tray, which never happens with real butter.
I tried whipping chilled canned coconut cream for a dairy-free topping but it stays soft and runny and will not hold peaks, even after several minutes of whipping.
My gluten-free sandwich loaf rose nicely in the tin but collapsed in the oven, and the inside is gummy and wet even after cooling for hours.
input.technicalDetails: Pre-mixed gluten-free flour blend, 220C for 15 minutes then 190C for 30

input.problem: These gluten-free oatmeal cookies are gritty and crumble apart as soon as I touch them, and they spread much more than the wheat version.
My gluten-free vanilla cake sank in the centre and is dry and sandy at the edges, even though a skewer came out clean.
input.technicalDetails: Rice flour and potato starch blend, 175C, 45 minutes

input.problem: I baked a vegan chocolate cake with no eggs or dairy. The top cracked badly and the crumb is dry and crumbly, nothing like the moist photo in the recipe.
input.technicalDetails: Oat milk, applesauce and vegetable oil, 180C for 50 minutes

input.problem: My dairy-free, gluten-free pie crust shrank away from the sides of the tin during blind baking and cracked when I tried to lift it out.
input.technicalDetails: Gluten-free flour blend with vegan butter, chilled 30 minutes
